description: This file defines an abstract repository interface for user preferences and its implementation that interacts with local data source, including methods for fetching, updating, setting individual preferences, seeding default preferences, and clearing preferences.

classes.name: PreferencesRepository
classes.description: Abstract interface defining methods for managing user preferences.

classes.name: LocalPreferencesRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PreferencesRepository using a local data source.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieve user preferences from local data source.

methods.name: setPreference
methods.description: Set a single preference toggle based on key.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Initialize default preferences if none exist.
